cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That penalty was worth the entry fee. We'll know exactly how to start next week's race.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You raised a red flag because the referee did. Competitors don't get to stop the race.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, an expensive demonstration of who controls the start. We won't pay for that lesson twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Practice is free on Tuesday. You could learn to wait for the starter then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Book us in. I'll watch which signal gets everyone moving and save our money for the actual race.

reason: Replace the unsupported confidence overlay with a concrete misunderstood copied action that directs the same-holder Drive pursuit, with a responsive partner and an ending using B4.
